aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: After a bitter fallout abroad shattered their friendship, two former best friends reluctantly reunite to organize the celebrity wedding of the year.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Susana and Elvira were once inseparable, but a disastrous trip abroad resulted in a bitter falling-out that kept them apart for two years. When an opportunity arises to coordinate the high-profile celebrity wedding of the town's hottest artists, the duo is forced to team up once again. Working under intense pressure with no backup plan, they must navigate demanding clients, unexpected romantic complications, and unresolved personal grievances. Ultimately, pulling off the massive event becomes a chaotic yet poignant journey toward repairing their broken bond.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Susana and Elvira were best friends whose once-unshakeable partnership imploded during a trip abroad, leading to two years of silence and estrangement. Their forced reunion occurs when they are offered the career-defining opportunity to organize the high-stakes celebrity wedding of two popular musical artists. Reluctantly agreeing to work together due to the magnitude of the project, both women are pushed to their limits with no safety net available. As high-stress preparations unfold, they face a relentless parade of chaotic wedding mishaps, demanding client requests, and eccentric venue challenges. Along the way, romantic entanglements and old grievances reemerge, constantly threatening to tear their partnership apart for good. Despite the friction, working side-by-side forces Susana and Elvira to confront the painful misunderstandings and hurt feelings that originally drove them apart. Through moments of shared laughter, emotional vulnerability, and mutual support under pressure, they begin to remember why they were so vital to each other's lives. In the end, as they pull off the lavish event, they accomplish something far more meaningful than a perfect wedding: rebuilding their deep, enduring friendship.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Susana and Elvira: No Plan B follows former best friends Susana and Elvira, who haven't spoken since a devastating fallout abroad ruined their personal and professional relationship two years prior. Destiny brings them back together when they are hired to plan the ultimate celebrity wedding for two of the biggest music stars in town. With high stakes, zero margin for error, and no backup plan, the pair must overcome their deep-seated resentment and function as a team once more. Packed with romantic drama, sharp comedy, and heartwarming moments, the film explores the chaotic world of event planning alongside the complex dynamics of female friendship, forgiveness, and second chances.

story_structure.climax: A major crisis occurs right before or during the wedding ceremony, threatening to destroy the event and forcing Susana and Elvira to confront the true root of their broken friendship.
story_structure.conflict: The women must balance their lingering personal resentment and unresolved past friction while navigating the intense pressure and high stakes of planning a flawless event.
story_structure.resolution: Through overcoming the ultimate test together, the two women reach a new understanding, salvaging both the wedding and their bond as they move forward into a new chapter.
story_structure.introduction: Susana and Elvira, two former best friends who grew distant after a falling out, are unexpectedly reunited when they are hired together to organize a high-profile celebrity wedding.
story_structure.risingAction: As wedding preparations spiral into chaos with demanding clients, tight deadlines, and unexpected mishaps, Susana and Elvira are forced to cooperate, causing old feelings and unresolved secrets to surface.
